title: Remote Cell spawn: satellite owner

effect.user: A satellite Cell is provisioned at the requested revision and can accept the first message.
assertions: Independent Cell checkout at pinned SHA
Real stub boot precedes first delivered message

idle.why: Separate idle workload; no spawn request.

first-use.why: New target repository and first runtime have distinct setup costs.

repeated.why: Repeated spawns reuse target repository; never call this cold disk.

scale.why: Single and four-wide starts are separate series.

background.why: No visible renderer in owner benchmark.

release.why: Fixture shutdown must reap every owned runner.

recovery.why: Failed attempts retained; retry/deduplication must preserve target and revision.

recipe.readiness: Disposable satellite daemon RPC hello; fixture origin ready before each batch
recipe.completion: Pinned checkout, real stub idle and delivered first mail verified; owned hosts reaped
recipe.reset: cold: new fixture origin per batch; warm: one excluded batch then reuse origin; OS caches never flushed
recipe.teardown: Existing daemon fixture helper stops runtimes and verifies host exit before deleting owned temp data
requires: idle designated target for comparative baselines

metrics.scope: RPC request to durable spawn admission, including client serialization
metrics.invariant: Every measured spawn uses its own Cell at the pinned SHA, origin unchanged, first mail delivered, zero tick/delivery violations, all owned hosts reaped.
metrics.noise: 15 ms polling plus RPC and scheduler delay; width 4 observations are correlated within each batch. Shared loaded host runs are recipe proof only.
